messages.subject: Lyra — retrofit progress for the HSE meeting
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Update for the HSE progress meeting next week: the first cell (CR-TR-12) has had the trapped-key interlock and dual-channel monitoring fitted and is awaiting the new PUWER sign-off. The remaining three cells are scheduled to be done by 23 May. Refresher training is booked for the week of 8 June. Are we still offering the inspector a site walk-round?

Neil
